name: D-K-Che Fruteria
notes: All 3 photos are menu boards on the shop wall. 1.jpg shows 8 boards (raspados, tostilocos/frutilocos, clamatos, special treats, fruit salads, tortas/sandwiches, smoothies, milkshakes/fresh drinks, breakfast, fresh-squeezed juices); 2.jpg and 3.jpg are closer/higher-res shots of some of the same boards. 1.jpg is low native resolution (1116x562); it was cropped and upscaled locally to read small text, but many prices remained too blurry to transcribe reliably and were omitted while item names/descriptions stayed legible. Two boards each have an item named 'Citrus Splash' with different ingredients (fruit-juice-smoothie board vs. fresh-squeezed-juice board); both kept as separate entries.
